 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. We can't help but wonder if the Dallas Cowboys regret trading for Joey Porter Jr. this season.
 The Cowboys made a huge splash earlier this month by sending a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick to the Steelers in exchange for Porter. The former Penn State star made it clear he wasn't going to play for Pittsburgh without a new deal.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement After making his debut for the Cowboys on Oct. 4 against the Texans, Porter missed their Week 5 game against the Buccaneers due to an illness. The belief was that he'd be a full-go for "Sunday Night Football" against the Packers, but his status is now up in the air.
 NFL insider Ed Werder reported Saturday that Porter rolled his ankle in practice earlier this week. He's currently listed as questionable for Week 6.
 "A source involved says Porter is hoping to play and that his game status has nothing to with his contract," Werder added. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Sep 27, 2026; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA; Pittsburgh Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. watches warm-ups for a game against the Cincinnati Bengals at Acrisure Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Barry Reeger-Imagn ImagesBarry Reeger-Imagn Images.
 Cowboys fans losing faith in Porter.
 Even though Werder said Porter's contract situation isn't influencing his status, fans are convinced it's causing a huge issue behind the scene.
 "One week after another, different excuse," a Cowboys fan wrote on X. 
 "I am starting to think he doesn't want to play until he gets his contract," a second fan wrote .
 "Lol great trade," another fan sarcastically said. 
 "This dude is scamming," a fan declared. "It couldn't be more obvious."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Cowboys desperately need Porter on the field if they're going to slow down Matthew Golden, Christian Watson and the Packers.
